grid.linkRowLabel: Take orders by private link and QR code
grid.columnTitle: The built-in Private type. It cannot be renamed, moved or deleted.

form.help: Shows on your schedule as “Private event” with the date and times only — never the address, the map or Village Foodie.
form.linkPromise: Guests order by a private link and QR code — you’ll get them after saving.
form.nameHelp: Guests see this at the top of the order page.
form.previewNote: How it shows on your schedule — no venue, town or postcode.
form.needsTimes: Add a start and end time — a private event taking orders by link needs them.

link.title: Private link & QR code
link.label: Private link
link.newLinkConfirm: Make a new link? The current link stops working straight away, and any QR codes you have already printed will stop working too.
link.newLinkHelp: Use this if the link has gone somewhere it shouldn’t. The current link stops working straight away, and printed QR codes stop working too.
link.newLinkFailed: Could not make a new link.
link.offNotice: Ordering by private link is switched off for this event, so there is no link to share. The event still shows on your schedule as “Private event”.

cards.blurb: Order and pay on your phone. We’ll call your name when it’s ready.

noSinglePost: Private events don’t get their own post — they appear on your weekly poster as “Private event”.
confirmToPrivate: This hides the address and the event from the map. Guests will need the private link to order.
confirmFromPrivate: This makes the event public: its address and map pin will show, and the private link will stop working.
